snippet.title: Eclipsium Release Trailer - 2025 Convergence Showcase
snippet.description:
Eclipsium is a perilous journey through a sunless world on the edge of collapse. Guided by a fading memory and a pale light, you traverse shifting landscapes haunted by a looming presence of her. There is only hunger, loss, and the hope that something still remains within the darkness. This mysterious trailer debuted as part of the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase.

Wishlist (or indeed buy!) the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419670
